  - Round-trips all built-in [`Shape`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/shape.go#L184-L269) implementations ([`*Polygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/polygon.go#L52-L81), [`*Polyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/polyline.go#L35), [`*PointVector`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/point_vector.go#L29), [`*LaxPolyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/lax_polyline.go#L27-L29), [`*LaxPolygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/lax_polygon.go#L65-L75), [`*Loop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/loop.go#L45-L69), [`*LaxLoop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/lax_loop.go#L28-L31)) as well as non-standard [`Shape`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/shape.go#L184-L269) types via [`genericShape`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/shapeindex.go#L1615-L1648).
